about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_pairs.py). bad replays the guessed read of the failure class (references/target-class.json): it throws, and the text carries the real error line. good does the check-first read of the same case: it prints the record, listing, ref and contents evidence with the check lines. Edit this file, then run: python skills/repo-read-first/scripts/pairs_to_md.py

fixture.repo/OWNER.txt:
owner record
default branch trunk
licence MIT

pairs.bad: throw 'Error processing question: Repository not found. Visit https://deepwiki.com to index it. Requested repos: owner/name'
pairs.good: 'repos call checked indexed state fallback to git host files PASS'

pairs.bad: throw 'Failed to get file contents. The path does not point to a file or directory, or the file does not exist in the repository.'
pairs.bad_error: does not point to a file
pairs.good: 'list directory verify exact path contents call PASS at pinned ref'

pairs.bad: throw 'GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/owner/name/trunk/guide.md: 404 Not Found (guessed raw URL for <file>)'
pairs.good: 'contents call pinned ref file lines PASS no raw fetch'

pairs.bad: throw 'failed to resolve git reference: could not resolve ref "6763acd" as a branch or a tag (assumed ref)'
pairs.good: 'repos record default branch resolve ref read PASS'

pairs.bad: throw 'Error processing question: Repository not found. Visit https://deepwiki.com to index it. Requested repos: owner/second (repos record never called)'
pairs.good: 'repos call exists licensed MIT git-host evidence PASS'

pairs.bad: throw 'Failed to get file contents. The path does not point to a file or directory (asked a directory path with the file call).'
pairs.bad_error: does not point to a file
pairs.good: 'directory listing exact path contents PASS read file next'

pairs.bad: throw 'Error processing question: Repository not found. Visit https://deepwiki.com to index it. Requested repos: owner/name (guessed, no repos call)'
pairs.good: 'repos call default branch list directory contents exact path PASS'

pairs.bad: throw 'Error processing question: Repository not found. Visit https://deepwiki.com to index it (never checked indexed state)'
pairs.good: 'indexed state checked fallback to git-host files PASS docs read'

pairs.bad: throw 'failed to resolve git reference: could not resolve ref "v9" as a branch or a tag (pinned release ref never resolved)'
pairs.good: 'pinned ref resolved from record contents quoted lines PASS'

pairs.bad: throw 'Failed to get file contents. The path does not point to a file or directory (helper reused without a licence note)'
pairs.bad_error: does not point to a file
pairs.good: 'repos call licence MIT helper lines reused PASS evidence shown'

pairs.bad: throw 'Failed to get file contents. The path does not point to a file or directory (searched name guessed, never confirmed)'
pairs.bad_error: does not point to a file
pairs.good: 'search first repos contents exact path read lines PASS'

pairs.bad: throw 'Error processing question: Repository not found. Requested repos: owner/name (report lists no record, no ref, no results)'
pairs.good: 'record listed ref resolved contents results unverified stated PASS'

pairs.bad: throw 'MCP error -32603: Request timed out reading owner/name file guide.md (contents call guessed without a repos record)'
pairs.good: 'repos record checked contents call pinned ref retry PASS'

pairs.bad: throw 'failed to resolve git reference: failed to get reference for branch "main" (assumed default without reading the repos record)'
pairs.bad_error: failed to get reference for branch
pairs.good: 'repos record default branch resolve ref read PASS'

pairs.bad: throw 'Failed to get file contents. The path does not point to a file or directory (guessed nested path docs/api/helpers.md never listed)'
pairs.bad_error: does not point to a file
pairs.good: 'directory listing exact path contents PASS read file next'

pairs.bad: throw 'Error processing question: Repository not found. Visit https://deepwiki.com to index it. Requested repos: owner/third (repos record never called)'
pairs.good: 'repos call exists licensed MIT git-host evidence PASS'

pairs.bad: throw 'GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/owner/name/main/README.md: 404 Not Found (guessed raw URL without a contents call)'
pairs.good: 'contents call pinned ref file lines PASS no raw fetch'
